_comment: Prestige: Charter milestones, Legacy scoring, founding sites, the Legacy perk tree and outposts. Typed in src/sim/legacy.ts; see docs/design/M5-spec.md.

charters.text: Halcyon Charter §12: a homestead of one hundred souls that has secured its neighbourhood may sponsor a new homestead. HALCY has already printed the ribbon.
Halcyon Charter §12(b): a sponsored homestead that reaches one hundred and has proven itself useful to the neighbourhood may sponsor another. The ribbon is reusable.

sites.name: Halcyon Plot 7
sites.description: A textbook site: flat, dry, and only slightly on fire. Recommended for first-time sponsors.

sites.name: The Dry Wells
sites.description: The water table is a rumour. Every drop is earned, and HALCY has started calling it 'hydration mindfulness'.

sites.name: Rustman Country
sites.description: Excellent salvage, friendly neighbours. The neighbours are friendly the way wolves are friendly.

sites.name: The Scorch
sites.description: Where the Glare hit hardest. Nothing grows, everything bites, and the view is incredible.
